explanation: For y1=e^{3x} and y2=xe^{3x}, W=e^{6x}. Variation of parameters gives u1=-∫2x/(1+x²) dx=-ln(1+x²) and u2=∫2/(1+x²) dx=2arctan(x). Thus g=e^{3x}(2x arctan(x)-ln(1+x²)), option d. Verification: the expression in parentheses has first derivative 2arctan(x) and second derivative 2/(1+x²), so g''-6g'+9g=2e^{3x}/(1+x²).
